1084-1531-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-1531-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-1531-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

401-2530-3944-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-6578.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Sephiroth trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

628-5523-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

2173-4771-5220-7492.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-7892.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-7892.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3478-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3478-4231-7824.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1987-3110-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

3457-4734-7791.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Cradle Clearcutter.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3738-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3738-5256-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2034-5189-6774-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-6774-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Loading Zone.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-2292-4681.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3899-4241-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

967-2557-3809-5147-7087.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-5295.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-5295.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-5475-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

2060-2700-2744-4499-6260.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

147-3047-5231.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2613-3432.easyPrerequisites: There is a land on the battlefield.
2613-3432.description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker and destroying a land.
Each Sliver you control triggers, dealing 20 damage to any target for each trigger.
2613-3432.notes: It is intended to perform this combo when you control many Slivers and/or it will end the game, but it is not necessary.

1456-2464-5051-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1456-2464-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4375-5315-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-4613-6260-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Caradora.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3680-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double.
3680-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
3680-4608-5466.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Stunt Double's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Stunt Double's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Stunt Double's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

215-527-713.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
When Selvala enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, giving Selvala haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

2921-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2921-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

883-1461-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3039-3258-4450-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion with flying.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1308-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating six 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers six times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat.

1315-4826-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
1315-4826-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

509-4222-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Idris.
509-4222-5116.description:
Activate Idris using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

1350-2104-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
1350-2104-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {2}{W}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1300-4222-4387-4992.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least three lands.
1300-4222-4387-4992.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Carpet of Flowers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least three lands, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least three lands, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.
